Construction Services in Kechi, KS

Kechi is a small north Sedgwick County community of roughly 2,500 residents northeast of Wichita. The town has a distinct character — a historic downtown district, rural acreage properties on the outskirts, and modest residential neighborhoods that attract homeowners looking for a small-town feel with quick Wichita access via K-254. Kechi Airport serves the general aviation community in the area.

The housing stock is varied — older properties in the original townsite with character to them, mid-century ranches on established streets, and newer construction on rural lots. Wheatland Construction serves Kechi and north Sedgwick County. We permit through the City of Kechi for in-town work and through Sedgwick County for rural properties outside city limits.

What We Build in Kechi

Custom Homes

Kechi's rural acreage lots are popular for custom home construction — larger lots with more distance from neighbors, in a community that retains its agricultural character. We build custom homes in the Kechi area from foundation through finish, permitting appropriately for the property location. See Custom Home Building in Kechi →

Home Additions

Kechi's older in-town properties frequently have limited square footage that doesn't match modern family needs. Room additions and master suite expansions are common requests. We match existing rooflines and exterior materials so additions look original to the home. See Home Additions in Kechi →

Basement Finishing

Kechi-area homes include properties with older basements in various states of completion. North Sedgwick County's soil drainage characteristics vary — we assess moisture conditions at every Kechi basement before recommending a scope. See Basement Finishing in Kechi →

Bathroom Remodeling

Kechi's older housing stock has original mid-century bathrooms with galvanized plumbing and dated finishes. We remodel them completely — new supply and drain where needed, new tile, new vanity, new fixtures. The result is a bathroom that actually works and looks good. See Bathroom Remodeling in Kechi →

Kitchen Remodeling

Kechi kitchens range from narrow original layouts in older homes to more functional layouts in mid-century and newer construction. We handle everything from full gut-and-replace to targeted upgrades — always with permits and our own crews. See Kitchen Remodeling in Kechi →

Major Remodels

Some Kechi properties need comprehensive renovation — older homes where multiple systems and finishes need addressing at once. We handle major remodel scopes with coordinated trades and full permit management. See Major Remodels in Kechi →

Roofing

North Sedgwick County sees spring hail and wind exposure. Kechi-area rural properties are often more exposed than in-town homes — we install roofing systems appropriate for the conditions and handle insurance documentation when applicable. See Roofing in Kechi →

Kechi Permit Jurisdiction

In-town Kechi properties permit through the City of Kechi. Rural properties outside city limits permit through Sedgwick County. We handle all permit applications and inspections.
